stages.title: Clause completeness
stages.body: Distinguish complete clauses, fragments, comma splices and subordinated units.

stages.title: Agreement controller
stages.body: Locate the grammatical subject, ignoring interrupting phrases.

stages.title: Special agreement
stages.body: Handle each/every, number expressions, fractions, there constructions and coordinated subjects.

stages.title: Tense timeline
stages.body: Place events on a timeline before choosing tense and aspect.

stages.title: Conditionals
stages.body: Preserve real/unreal time, polarity and result.

stages.title: Articles
stages.body: Choose a/an by sound, the by identifiability and zero article for general plural/mass reference.

stages.title: Determiners
stages.body: Control few/a few, little/a little, fewer/less, each/every and other/another.

stages.title: Preposition patterns
stages.body: Learn verb/adjective/noun plus preposition as complete constructions.

stages.title: Conjunction logic
stages.body: Match clause type and avoid double conjunctions.

stages.title: Parallelism and comparison
stages.body: Coordinate grammatically equivalent units and compare like with like.

stages.title: Modifier placement
stages.body: Attach opening and internal modifiers to their intended heads.
